usedFor: HeySummit holds your summit registrations, and Asana gets a task from “New Attendee” through “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each registration becomes a task with assignee and dates, so someone owns the welcome and follow up.

watchOut: “Ticket Purchased” fires when an attendee registers too, so using both creates two tasks for one person.
